purpose: Create an original, identity-lockable Open Reviewer character for the EVAVO Council before any animation production begins.

views.label: full body slight right three-quarter
views.prompt: Eye-level full-body presentation, slight right three-quarter orientation, complete head, hands and shoes visible, relaxed asymmetric stance, natural hands and no dramatic perspective.

views.label: full body slight left three-quarter
views.prompt: Same exact person and clothing from a slight left three-quarter orientation, eye level, complete silhouette and both hands clearly readable.

views.label: neutral identity bust
views.prompt: Neutral chest-up identity view of the same exact person, alert relaxed expression, face and close-cropped natural hair clear enough for continuity review.

style.lock: EVAVO-crafted editorial character design with premium creative-studio art direction. Original adult gender-neutral creative technologist with a warm dark complexion, close-cropped natural hair and an alert relaxed expression. Off-white structured studio/work jacket over a simple black shirt, dark straight trousers and grounded dark footwear. One small cherry-red stitched utility detail only. Slightly relaxed asymmetric stance, practical and independent rather than polished-corporate or futuristic. Realistic anatomy and fabric construction, clean readable silhouette, no generic AI-assistant styling.
style.continuity: Every view in a candidate set must show the same exact person, facial structure, age, skin tone, hair shape, jacket construction, black base layer, trouser fit, proportions, handedness, footwear, cherry-red stitch placement, baseline and material language. Do not redesign between views.
mustHave: complete adult human anatomy with natural hands and five stable fingers per visible hand
warm dark complexion and consistent close-cropped natural hair
off-white structured studio or work jacket
simple black shirt and dark straight trousers
one small restrained cherry-red stitched utility detail
strong readable silhouette distinct from EVA, Top Hat Man and the Critic
genuine transparent background with no scene or floor plate
mustAvoid: holograms or floating user interface elements
robot parts, glowing eyes, headsets, smart glasses or futuristic armour
Top Hat Man Victorian hat, moustache or historical tailoring
Critic silver-black bob and charcoal high-collar coat
logos, readable text, watermark, scenery or checkerboard transparency
cropped head, hands, fingers, feet or jacket hem
style.originality: Create a new EVAVO-owned Open Reviewer identity from this art direction. Do not reconstruct, imitate or closely derive any protected fictional character, celebrity, stock mascot or existing AI-assistant character. The result should feel like a distinctive member of one EVAVO editorial cast rather than a recognisable external archetype.
